notes.title: More detailed view on Ignited Steel: Uprising 1.1
notes.content:
We are getting good feedback from players and we wanted to share with this new update a more detailed view on what this new patch brings to the table!

As some of you may already know, the [b]1.1 Uprising update[/b] comes with the new [b]Ignited Steel: Prologue[/b], which[b] will replace the free demo[/b] from this day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/f148f8dcb1d7217f86249a88e67c8131d91843c3.png[/img]

The prologue is a[b] free trial[/b] version that fulfills the same function as the demo, giving the player a taste of what he may find in [b]Ignited Steel[/b]. This new prologue is longer than the original demo and dives deeper into the lore and history of [b]Ignited Steel[/b], so that experienced players can also enjoy it.

As I was saying, the[b] Ignited Steel[/b] demo will be deactivated today and the prologue will become the free trial version for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/55d2f23bc748f7ce793a14e9c6b624c27c87cfeb.gif[/img]

This [b]Ignited Steel 1.1 update[/b] brings new content for all players:

- New [b]characters[/b] for your squad, with brand new abilities and that become part of the game's story.

- New [b]weapons[/b], to equip your team. Customize your way-to-proceed through the galaxy. 

- New [b]biomes[/b], which alter the way you play, modifying the weather conditions.

- New [b]threats[/b], with a new special enemy that has 3 different versions, each one more powerful.

With this update[b] we also solve some bugs and minor errors [/b]that the players were reporting us, as for example a black screen and blocking of the app due to an integration of the game with discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/d94f67199311a2f1c7629e2f61a37e30fdf9e87a.gif[/img]

With the arrival of Ignited Steel: Uprising 1.1 we have also included a new language, [b]Simplified Chinese[/b].

[hr][/hr]
各位玩家好！点燃的钢铁终于有中文版了。我们希望您认为该游戏具有良好的本地化并且您可以享受它！ 我们决定将其完全翻译成这种语言，这样您就可以享受我们认为您会喜欢的游戏。如果您有任何问题，请随时与我们联系。 此致！

[hr][/hr]

We hope this update finds you enjoying this new free content we have released.

Please, do not hesitate to let us know your suggestions or any problem you may encounter through the forums, in our [url=https://discord.gg/895vmPBsKx][b]discord[/b][/url] or in our [url=https://twitter.com/meterobyte_Stu][b]twitter[/b][/url].

Best regards.

notes.title: Ignited Steel: Prologue and a new update on Monday!
notes.content:
[b]It's finally here![/b]

The Ignited Steel: Uprising update will arrive on Steam on Monday, October 17th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/7296b5ec80a7b7b542e6d6d7f7cfb1bbbaf858d8.png[/img]

As you may assume, this new update serves as a completely [b]free DLC [/b]for players who already have Ignited Steel in their libraries. But for those who don't, [b]Ignited Steel: Uprising[/b] will have a 25% discount during the first week after its public release so tell a friend! Spread the word! It's a good chance to get it!

Also, if you want to take a look at what is coming and you can’t wait until Monday, we have enabled a new Steam page to launch the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015040/Ignited_Steel_Prologue/][b]Ignited Steel Prologue[/b][/url]. This prologue will serve two main functions, it is a free demo for players who want to take a look at it before buying the full game and also to dive into the story behind this universe. 

This prologue will take you to the events that turned Phar0s, the most advanced AI created by man to date, into an evil software that seeks to constantly expand itself through space.

This new update includes more biomes, which will modify your team’s[b] way-to-proceed[/b], new weapons to equip your squad during the adventure and new enemies with varying degrees of difficulty that you will find as you progress in your adventure.

With this update we also introduce [b]Chinese localization[/b], so that more people can enjoy Ignited Steel!
We would also like to say that the consoles port is on its way and you will have more news about this soon.

We wish you to have a good time trying the prologue during this weekend, making the wait for full release easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/6f53ffe00d34b221da97f77b679fa9c2d5637fc1.png[/img]

See you on Monday!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello!

This week patch is finally here right before the weekend! Expect more improvements in more patches next week.

We've been working on fixing things related to enemy spawns and their position.

These errors have been fixed thanks to your feedback, so please keep those suggestions coming!

Here's a change log with the details of the update!

Have a nice weekend and see you soon!

[hr] [/hr]

## [1.0.6] - 2022-04-01
    
### Fixed
    - Solved bug that made combat reward modules always appear at level 1.
    - Fixed new game plus icons in the star map.
    - Inconsistencies between the heat-related values displayed in equipped 
    module's UI and their actual dealt heat.
    - Removed incorrect enemy from tutorial levels.

### Known issues
    - Tooltips appear out of display bounds at certain screen resolutions.
    - Certain UI elements overlap each other at 1440p screen resolution.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Weekend patch with several of your suggestions, a few bug fixes and stability improvements, some quality-of-life enhancements, and balancing.

Thanks for playing the game! Expect more improvements in a few more patches next week. Especially balance-wise. We are preparing a batch of changes that will make the game [b]a little harder, but also a little bit more fair[/b]. We are aiming for the game to be a bit more demanding at the baseline, and at the same time polishing off some of the difficulty highs and lows, as we feel it's a little too "spiky" right now.

Anyways, please keep those suggestions coming. Some of you will recognize changes in this patch that you have proposed yourself!

Time for a good weekend's rest! Boy do we need it. We'll be fresh back on Monday to continue working on the game!

Have a nice weekend everyone!
 [hr][/hr] 
Changelog:

### Added

notes.title: Ignited Steel free demo is finally here!
notes.content:
After almost two years of development, we are finally approaching the release date for Ignited Steel, our turn-based tactics game where you control a squad of outdated robots with the purpose of saving the entire galaxy from an evil A.I.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/57c790c6a3fe0d58e3485eac727c46ae65edee9c.jpg[/img]

In this demo version, you will travel through several planets and find different game types along your journey.

Its just a short version of the final game which will be composed by 3 different acts, offering a longer experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/04f82c222dcec0bfb498f91bf3b64127c97a6ed2.gif[/img]

Hope you like what its coming to Steam this March 9th!

notes.title: We are on beta-testing!
notes.content:
Hey! Welcome!

As previously said, the[b] Ignited Steel [/b]launching is coming and we are already on beta-testing!

Yokaicade also trusted us on the organization of this process as publishers. We recruited a group of 15 volunteers to help us balance, fix and add things with their feedback before the launch! We cannot specify a date in case we are forced to delay it, but what we do can say is that a few of the Yokaicade devs will be streaming Ignited Steel on the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. It will take part on Feb 21 - 28 and they will release a free demo available for everybody!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/04f82c222dcec0bfb498f91bf3b64127c97a6ed2.gif[/img]

We also want to mention that we changed the name of the game for this final and intensive marketing process before launching! We went from “[b]Ignited Steel: MECHA TBT[/b]” to “[b]Ignited Steel: MECH TACTICS[/b]”. Ignited Steel is planned to be a [b]pure tactics game with roguelike elements[/b], such as mechas customization and events along your way. The previous title may confuse some players and we want this feature to be clear for the public.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/fca206ccf02acc057492507ca24fc9c95dd521e0.png[/img]

Last but not least, we want to let you know we have an [b]official release trailer[/b] on its way. Its almost done but we are giving it some last few details to charm you all! We are really excited for you to see it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/944a0a05bb875a880ffebe7db07b81b7d9638872.png[/img]

See you soon!

notes.title: Ignited Steel dev-log
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Ignited Steel launch is coming up and although we wont confirm a release date (but really really soon) we are here to talk about the game’s development.

YokaiCade’s team has made great progress both with the narrative as well as the gameplay. In its current state, Ignited Steel has a completely developed campaign even with its final bosses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/a91d659cb2653c5cbec4610dcaba98c5412a81dd.png[/img]

One of the latest features that Yokaicade introduced on the game is the camera rotation which allows you to guide yourself through the battle and observe from every angle how your mechas destroy the enemy units. This was something we created after receiving feedback from people close to us who had played the game as well as the fast forward buttons for enemy turns.

We have improved the playstyle of the game, adding a big amount of different kinds of weapons that combined with the overheating mechanic give variability and replayability to the game, offering the player a fresh experience every time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/fd6439bafd066eb636d633e63cacbfcff420cf0c.gif[/img]

In Ignited Steel you will find different types of weapons such as ranged, melee, weapons you can use to move around the map and weapons that knockback your enemies and leave them defenseless.

Combining this with the overheat mechanic, Ignited Steel offers the player versatility for their combat style. With the overheat mechanic we will deal more damage to our enemies but we will be more vulnerable so we need to be careful on which strategy we choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857541/daea39a653b812b46ec385016b5acde2b99cd2c1.gif[/img]

The battlefield will play a key role in the gameplay. The climatic conditions will affect the rate at which our mechas will heat up. At this time, we have 3 different battlefields, cold, warm and neutral.

Stay tuned this upcoming weeks for more details about the Ignited Steel development and its release date!

Thank you for reading and see you soon!
